name: Sim wheel to RC car bridge device

mentions.name: Sim wheel to RC car bridge device
mentions.description: A hardware device that acts as a bridge between a video game sim wheel controller and a radio control car. It uses ESP32 microcontrollers on both ends communicating via the ESP-NOW protocol. Developed over about two years with a client, featuring custom coding and full board design by the author, with a separate freelancer designing the enclosure; the final PCBs have just arrived.
